Traditional tale: 神农尝百草

(none)

This scene:
神农和他的家人住在古代，所以不知道什么植物能吃。因为他的家人常常生病了，所以神农和他的哥哥一起去旅行找可以吃的植物。他们去很多不一样的地方，比方说高山、山谷和沙漠。

Expressiveness ideas:
1. After the family’s illness, add Shen Nong’s feeling to show his motivation: “神农看着常常生病的家人，心里很着急。”
2. When listing the places, add a few sensory details: “高山很高，山谷很深，沙漠又干又热。”
3. Before the journey, add a short line of dialogue: “我们去找能吃的植物吧！”

ideas.reason: It adds a clear feeling that supports why Shen Nong decides to search for edible plants.
It gives concrete, simple descriptions of the places they travel through.
